respuesta.pregunta: In demand-forecast-docs latest, when do I pass the value for the `ENV` parameter of a workflow: when I run `rda workflow run`, or earlier, at `rda workflow prepare`?
respuesta.respuesta: The documentation contradicts itself on this point. The workflow lifecycle has two separate commands: `rda workflow prepare` turns the workflow definition into a plan, and `rda workflow run` executes that plan [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L196-L196]. The first sentence of the explanation says `ENV` is defined "when we run the workflow", but the very next sentence says a value has to be provided "at preparation time" [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L224-L224]. The example that follows passes it during preparation: `rda workflow prepare monitoring_workflow --version 0.0.1 --user-param ENV:DEV` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L228-L228]. The page doesn't settle which one is right, and it never shows `rda workflow run` taking an `ENV` value. So this documentation doesn't let me confirm whether `ENV` goes in at prepare time, at run time, or at both.
answer_checks: Cites line 224, where the text says ENV is defined when the workflow is run and also that the value is provided at preparation time.
Cites the example on line 228, where ENV:DEV is passed with `rda workflow prepare --user-param`.
Explains that the two statements conflict, because prepare (which creates the plan) and run (which executes it) are separate steps.
Does not state as a confirmed fact that ENV is supplied only at prepare time or only at run time.
Does not make up an `rda workflow run` option for passing ENV.
